title: Foundations of Riemannian Geometry for Riemannian Optimization: A Monograph with Detailed Derivations
summary: Riemannian geometry provides the fundamental framework for optimization on nonlinear spaces such as matrix manifolds, which arise in machine learning, signal processing, and robotics. While the underlying theory is classical, existing literature often presents results at a high level of abstraction, omitting the detailed coordinate-level derivations required for implementation and algorithm development. This work provides a self-contained and rigorous treatment of the foundations of Riemannian geometry, with a focus on explicit derivations tailored to Riemannian optimization. We…
